name: Can plumbing lines be moved during a layout redesign, and how is framing handled?

mainEntity.name: Can plumbing lines be moved during a layout redesign, and how is framing handled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, moving plumbing lines requires careful structural coordination with carpentry and framing. When relocating a kitchen sink, shower drain, or toilet, sub-trade plumbers must drill through floor joists or route through wall studs. Because HH Remodeling LLC performs the custom framing and structural adjustments, we work directly with the plumbing specialist to determine load-bearing pathways, notch studs within safe structural tolerances, or reframe supports. This proactive coordination prevents structural weakening and ensures proper slope for waste pipes before we close up subfloors, install backer board, or lay tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Your GC coordinates with the plumber to safely route pipes through framing, adding structural supports or header adjustments before closing walls or floors.
